Indian startup aims to build advanced rocket engine

A two-year-old Indian startup is reportedly working on developing a complex rocket engine, a technology previously achieved only by SpaceX. This endeavor aims to position India among a select group of nations capable of such advanced aerospace engineering. The project is distinct from the work of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).
